name: Daventry Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Daventry Community Centre. Open Tue and Fri for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: West Northamptonshire Council Allotments
short_description: WNCC allotment sites in Daventry area
description: Council manages sites at Daventry and nearby villages. Plots from £30/year. Waiting lists operate. Includes water access and storage facilities.

name: Daventry Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at Daventry Country Park
description: Volunteer-run community garden within Daventry Country Park. Grows seasonal vegetables with harvest shared among volunteers. Open weekends during growing season.
